page.overview:
What is Unidentified Noghri cleansing team?

A group of Noghri served as a cleansing team near Mount Tantiss.

The cleansing team was mentioned in the novel Specter of the Past, written by Timothy Zahn and published in 1997 as part one of the Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology.
